issue_request: FHIR-29323 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for the DomainResource Search section. It requested replacing unclear text about searching extensions with guidance that core does not define SearchParameters for most extensions, implementers may define their own, names have no formal rules but SHOULD make the extension linkage obvious, and expressions typically use an extension(...).value path with any necessary path and constraints.
